decisions.id: W72-1 Kuwabata's bare runs closed on measure
decisions.summary: Row 125's fix (re-measure on the current map; fill the runs where they stand) closed with no planting change because the hole law finds no hole on any shipped belt; 0072's drawing-page comment restated.
decisions.why: The fix's fill is conditional on the runs still standing; re-run independently over the five pool manifests: Inashiro, Kuwabata and Sawada 0 holes, Kashikawa and Mizuguchi no belt. On Kuwabata the across-wind sequence of all 95 crowns has NO opening over 30 ft at all, so no exemption (page cut, crossing, run break) is hiding one; the one opening on Inashiro (32 ft) is a page-cut bin. The research's rule (no visible opening over 30 ft) holds as measured, so closing changes nothing the GM asked for.

decisions.summary: Row 195's fix (draw the outfall run as the drain's dug ditch at drain width and role, running to the map edge, not a brook) closed by restating _comb_brook's docstring and claim, no map change.
decisions.why: Read settlement/fields/comb.py _comb_draw_ditches: the run is drawn by outfall_run at the drain channel's w_tail, ditch_style('drain') hue and class, into the late block, recorded in M['channels'] with frm kind drain and to offmap (feature 230/287); the hamlet path clears net['brook'] entirely (hamletgen/water/comb.py:69).
